_source: Measured host behaviour, not invented test data. These tables are the
recorded output of two probe scripts run in After Effects on 2026-08-21
behaviours, and test_ae_export.js asserts the re-enactment reproduces
these rows exactly - so mock drift fails a test instead of hiding a bug
the way a hand-maintained mock can. If a future probe run contradicts a
row, change this file WITH the probe evidence, never to make a test pass.

read_back_on_a_key._rule: the anchor is renamed: start of segment i returns as end of segment i-1; order is preserved; entry i keeps its own radius

read_back_interpolated._rule: additionally regrouped by type, every non-negative before every negative, stably; measured identical for LINEAR and BEZIER keys
